mapper.sql: O.ORDER_ID, O.QUOTE_ID, O.CUST_ID, C.CUST_NM, O.ORDER_DT, O.ORDER_AMT, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.CONTRACT_ID, O.CLOSE_YN, O.CLOSE_YM, O.CHARGE_USER_ID, O.REG_DT, O.UPD_DT
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM TB_ORDER O LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CUSTOMER C ON C.CUST_ID = O.CUST_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT I.ORDER_ID, I.ITEM_SEQ, I.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NM, I.QTY, I.UNIT_PRICE, I.AMT FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM I LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID WHERE I.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY I.ITEM_SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ORDER (ORDER_ID, QUOTE_ID, CUST_ID, ORDER_DT, ORDER_AMT, ORDER_STATUS, CLOSE_YN, CHARGE_USER_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{quoteId}, #{custId}, #{orderDt}, #{orderAmt}, '접수', 'N', #{chargeUserId}, NOW())
INSERT INTO TB_ORDER_ITEM (ORDER_ID, ITEM_SEQ, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, UNIT_PRICE, AMT) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{itemSeq}, #{productId}, #{qty}, #{unitPrice}, #{amt})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ORDER SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
UPDATE TB_ORDER SET CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId}, ORDER_STATUS = '계약완료', UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
UPDATE TB_ORDER SET ORDER_AMT = #{orderAmt}, UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
UPDATE SET CLOSE_YN = 'Y', CLOSE_YM = #{closeYm}, UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE ORDER_STATUS = '수금완료' AND CLOSE_YN = 'N' AND DATE_FORMAT(ORDER_DT, '%Y%m') <= #{closeYm}
